newsitem.title: USA: Horizon Air reduces some fares by 40 pct.
newsitem.headline: Horizon Air reduces some fares by 40 pct.

text.p: Horizon Air said Sunday it has reduced its lowest fares by up to 40 percent for travel from August 28 through December 16.
Tickets must be purchased by August 22, the airline said.
The sale applies to travel on Horizon flights from California, Idaho, Montana, Oregon, Washington, British Columbia and Alberta.
Tickets must be purchased one day after reservations are made. Tickets are non-refundable and a Saturday night stay over is required before returning.
Sale prices are not valid November 25, 26, 30, and December 1, and also to or from Canada October 10, 13 and 14.
Horizon is a subsidiary of Alaska Air Group Inc.
